title: Migrate CRM documentation to developer guide following fumadocs conventions
body:
Migrated English documentation from `examples/app-crm/docs` to `content/docs/developer` as a structured developer guide.

## Changes

**File migrations** (all converted to `.mdx` with fumadocs frontmatter):
- `README.md` → `index.mdx` - CRM application overview
- `01-data-modeling.md` → `data-modeling.mdx` - Object schema, field types, relationships
- `02-business-logic.md` → `business-logic.mdx` - Validations, workflows, triggers, formulas
- `05-security.md` → `security.mdx` - Profiles, permissions, sharing rules
- `08-ai-capabilities.md` → `ai-capabilities.mdx` - AI agents, RAG pipelines
- `STANDARDS.md` → `standards.mdx` - Development conventions

**Navigation structure**:
- Added `content/docs/developer/meta.json` defining page order
- Updated root `content/docs/meta.json` to include developer section

**Link normalization**:
- Stripped numerical prefixes from all filenames (`01-`, `02-`, etc.)
- Updated internal references to use extension-less paths (`./data-modeling` vs `./01-data-modeling.md`)

Build verified: all pages generated successfully at `/en/docs/developer/*`
